title: Forward rates from covered interest parity
source:
"""Forward FX under covered interest parity, annually compounded rates.

forward = spot * (1 + quote_rate)^T / (1 + base_rate)^T
forward_points = forward - spot
annualised_premium = (forward / spot)^(1/T) - 1   (== (1+rq)/(1+rb) - 1, asserted)
"""
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

INPUT = "/input/environment/data/fx_inputs.csv"
OUT = "/app/output/forwards.csv"


def main() -> None:
    fx = pd.read_csv(INPUT)
    s = fx["spot"].to_numpy(float)
    rb = fx["base_rate"].to_numpy(float)
    rq = fx["quote_rate"].to_numpy(float)
    t = fx["tenor_years"].to_numpy(float)

    fwd = s * (1.0 + rq) ** t / (1.0 + rb) ** t
    prem = (fwd / s) ** (1.0 / t) - 1.0
    assert np.allclose(prem, (1.0 + rq) / (1.0 + rb) - 1.0, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-13)

    out = pd.DataFrame({"pair_id": fx["pair_id"], "forward": fwd,
                        "forward_points": fwd - s, "annualised_premium": prem})
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    out.to_csv(OUT, index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    assert list(pd.read_csv(OUT).columns) == ["pair_id", "forward", "forward_points", "annualised_premium"]
    print(out.head())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
